scenario.note: One documented scenario. The methodology supports alternatives.

chat.light.description: A quick single question. A definition, a short explanation, or a one-off task, answered and done in a single exchange.

chat.typical.description: A short back-and-forth. A question, an answer, and a follow-up or two to refine or clarify it.

chat.heavy.description: An extended conversation. Many turns exploring a topic in depth, with the model reasoning at length before each reply.

agentic.light.description: A short assistant session. A focused change to one part of a codebase, started and finished within about an hour.

agentic.typical.description: A working session. An hour or two of the assistant reading files, making changes and checking its own work across a project.

agentic.heavy.description: A long-running project. A full day of assistant work, delegating to parallel helper agents and holding a large codebase in context.
